clips.title: The story
paras: At Windshear Crag, Unidentified Ore draws the Venture Company's attention. Piznik recovered a sample and passed it to Ziz Fizziks for study in Undermine.

The Venture Company's clear-cutting and strip mining at Windshear Crag exposed unusual mineral strata in the Stonetalon Mountains. The site's new boss, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, ordered large amounts of strange gold-green ore mined. Demoted goblin worker Piznik remained loyal to his fired former boss, Ziz Fizziks, and secured a sample while plotting his exit from the outfit. He handed it to a traveler bound for the crag's western ridge. Ziz planned to send most of the ore to Undermine for study and keep a small cut for personal profit.
